title: Salesforce Developer OmniStudio
description:
About OSF Digital:

OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner , we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.


Join Our Team:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Developer with strong knowledge in OmniStudio to join our innovative team! The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing Salesforce solutions that meet our clients' needs, utilizing OmniStudio tools to create dynamic, customer-centric applications. If you are passionate about Salesforce development and eager to contribute to a dynamic team, we would love to hear from you!


Job Description:

  • Develop solutions using Omni Studio tools such as OmniScripts, Data Raptors, Integration Procedures, and FlexCards to build dynamic, customer-centric applications.
  • Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand functional requirements and translate them into technical designs.
  • Create technical specifications and designs for Omni Studio components that align with project objectives and Salesforce best practices.
  • Customize and configure the Salesforce platform using declarative tools to meet business needs, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce technologies as needed.
  • Implement integrations with third-party systems using Salesforce APIs and middleware solutions.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, including unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing to ensure the quality and functionality of the solutions.
  • Manage the deployment process using tools like Salesforce DX, change sets, or version control systems, ensuring smooth transitions from development to production environments.
  • Create detailed documentation for developed solutions, including design documents, user guides, and maintenance instructions.
  • Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for deployed solutions, addressing any issues that arise in a timely manner.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of Omni Studio solutions, ensuring they operate efficiently within Salesforce governor limits.
  • Work closely with project managers, other developers, and quality assurance teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Engage with clients to gather feedback, understand their evolving needs, and make recommendations for enhancements or new features.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with the team, contributing to the collective expertise and professional development of colleagues.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest Salesforce releases, Omni Studio updates, and industry trends to continuously improve skills and knowledge.
  • Ensure that all development work complies with company policies, industry standards, and Salesforce security guidelines.


Requirements:

  • Integration Procedure
  • Data Raptor
  • Omniscript
  • FlexCard
  • Calculation Matrices
  • Validation Rule
  • Flow
  • Profile
  • Lightning Page
  • Role
  • Apex
  • LWC


Skill Set:

  • Omni Studio Proficiency: Strong experience with Omni Studio tools, including OmniScripts, Data Raptors, Integration Procedures, and FlexCards.
  • Salesforce Development: Proficiency in Apex programming, Visualforce pages, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Declarative Tools: Expertise in using Salesforce's declarative tools for customization.
  • Integration Skills: Experience with Salesforce APIs and middleware solutions.
  • Testing: Ability to write comprehensive test cases and perform various testing methods.
  • Version Control: Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
  • Deployment: Experience with deployment methodologies and tools like Salesforce DX.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Agile Methodology: Understanding of Agile development practices.
  • Continuous Learning: Commitment to staying current with Salesforce features and updates.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções para o setor de telecomunicações.
  • Colaborar na definição da arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar ativamente da sustentação das integrações existentes e evolução de novos produtos.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores.
  • Apoiar processos de pré-vendas e apresentações técnicas para clientes.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java (preferência para Java 11+).
  • Proficiência com Spring Boot e ecossistema Spring (Web, Security, Data).
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ) e microserviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Vivência com Docker, Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Familiaridade com API Gateways como Kong ou Apigee.
  • Experiência com observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger ou ELK).


Competências Comportamentais:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas técnicas.
  • Habilidade para gerenciar projetos e atuar em um ambiente de alta complexidade.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para clientes.
  • Proatividade para identificar e resolver problemas técnicos.
  • Visão sistêmica sobre o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Golang.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento front-end (React, Vue ou Angular).
  • Conhecimento de segurança de APIs e práticas de CQRs.
  • Experiência com PL/SQL e tuning de queries.

  • Quiser ter a possibilidade de aprender e trabalhar com diversas tecnologias;

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.


    • Experiências Desejáveis (não obrigatórias, mas valorizadas)
    • Projetos com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , eventos de domínio e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
    • Experiência implementando estratégias de resiliência  (retry, fallback, circuit breaker).
    • Projetos de monitoramento avançado com telemetria e métricas de performance.
    • Participação em arquiteturas escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.



    Diferenciais
    • Ter trabalhado com Ext.js  em sistemas legados.
    • Experiência em Blazor  (Server ou WebAssembly).
    • Portfólio com projetos relevantes em produção.

title: Gerente de projetos de TI
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Como Gerente de Projetos, você trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe do Studio Rx e os times de Projetos e Client Services nos EUA. Diariamente, você deverá monitorar as atividades dos projetos em andamento, identificando e mitigando riscos, além de manter uma comunicação fluída entre todas as equipes envolvidas.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento do plano do projeto: desde o entendimento e definição do escopo/briefing, passando pela estimativa de esforço e elaboração de cronogramas;
  • Alocação de equipe de acordo com habilidades necessárias, experiência e disponibilidade em parceria com o líder técnico da área de execução do projeto;
  • Gerenciamento e monitoramento das atividades diárias do projeto, garantindo o recebimento de todas as informações e materiais para execução das atividades, seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, consolidando as informações em relatórios para a liderança sênior do projeto;
  • Garantir a comunicação entre os times de execução e demais envolvidos no projeto;
  • Esclarecimento de dúvidas quanto ao direcionamento da execução das atividades, interagindo com equipes responsáveis pelo projeto nos EUA;
  • Garantir a execução das atividades de acordo com prazos e tempo estimado, com a qualidade exigida, e seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Elaboração de relatórios de andamento do projeto, e demais relatórios necessários para acompanhamento dos principais indicadores de sucesso das áreas de atuação.


Pré-Requisitos:

  • Inglês fluente (escrito e falado), pois trabalhará diretamente com times globais;
  • Graduação em áreas relacionadas à comunicação (Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração, Comunicação Social) ou TI (Processamento de dados, Análise de sistemas, Ciências da Computação);
  • Experiência consolidada com gestão de projetos.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em agências de comunicação/publicidade;
  • Experiência no segmento healthcare (certificação Veeva é um plus);
  • Proficiência em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (Agile, Scrum etc.);
  • Proficiência em sistemas e/ou softwares de gerenciamento de projetos (MSFT Project, Workfront, Jira etc.)
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas usadas por desenvolvedores front-end e de campanhas digitais (Google Web Designer, Doubleclick Studio, GitHub, Adobe Creative Suite etc.).



Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Analista de Projetos (Pl/Sr)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!


Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Projetos para se unir ao nosso Time de Projects para:

  • Participação de reuniões internas e externas com clientes;
  • Organização das demandas de projetos de acordo o processo definido, com boas práticas do PMBOK e metodologias ágeis;
  • Gerenciamento de solicitações e atividades não previstas em projetos;
  • Realização de atividades operacionais de gestão de projetos;
  • Gerenciamento de contas de projetos de clientes nacionais e internacionais;
  • Acompanhamento de reuniões e atividades de marcos de projetos;
  • Acompanhamento KPIs de projetos;
  • Asseguração da conformidade com padrões e procedimentos internos;
  • Facilitação da comunicação com Stakeholders;
  • Condução de revisões periódicas de projetos;
  • Gerenciamento e planejamento de marcos de faturamento (garantia de receita);
  • Treinamento e suporte à equipe de projetos (exclusivo - Senior)


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Formação completa em TI ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência de ao menos um ano (Pleno)/ dois anos (Senior) atuando como líder de projetos em contato direto com clientes;
  • Conhecimento sólido em MS Projects, Excel, Cronogramas;
  • Conhecimentos de PMBOK/Scrum/Kanban;
  • Espanhol avançado.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento em Jira;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento com produtos ou com conceitos relacionados a meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: Assistente de coleta de dados
description:
Sobre a vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional organizado(a), analítico(a), responsável por coletar, organizar e registrar informações relevantes em diferentes contextos, garantindo a qualidade e precisão dos dados coletados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar a coleta de dados remotamente, conforme orientações e padrões internos.
  • Garantir a precisão e a integridade dos dados registrados.

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware
description:
Desenvolvedor de Firmware | CLT | 100% Remota


Sobre nós e Resumo da posição

A Control iD é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial.

Aqui você terá a chance de criar soluções que conectam +300 mil dispositivos IoT e impactam +1 milhão de usuários ativos, em um ambiente que valoriza inovação e liberdade tecnológica.


O que buscamos:

  • Forte experiência em C++ e sistemas embutidos/embarcados;
  • Vivência com Linux ;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas embarcados ;
  • Experiência em otimização de performance, consumo e recursos de hardware;
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de comunicação (UART, SPI, I2C, TCP/IP, etc.);
  • Boas práticas de segurança e qualidade de código;
  • Atuação em metodologias ágeis.


Seu papel será:

Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de firmware — desde a concepção, arquitetura, implementação até os testes — sempre com foco em segurança, performance e escalabilidade para produtos conectados.


Diferenciais da vaga:

  • 100% remoto;
  • VR sem desconto em folha;
  • Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar;
  • PLR + Seguro de Vida;
  • Totalpass;
  • Participação prática nos produtos desenvolvidos pela empresa.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Hartmann Young is partnered with a fast-growing global leader in health, nutrition, and wellness ingredients, known for its science-led innovation and rapid international expansion. As the business continues to scale, we are seeking a dynamic Business Development Manager South America to drive immediate commercial impact and elevate the company’s presence across the nutraceutical market.


We’re looking for someone who brings genuine industry influence, including:

  • A strong book of business and established relationships with brand owners, CMOs/CDMOs, and major consumer health companies
  • Proven success selling key nutraceutical dosage forms — tablets, capsules, softgels, and gummys.


If you’re commercially driven, well-connected, and excited by the opportunity to shape partnerships in a high-growth environment, this role offers an exceptional platform to make a meaningful and immediate impact.


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive new business growth by leveraging your existing network and opening high-value commercial opportunities
  • Develop and expand strategic partnerships with global key accounts, brand owners, distributors, and contract manufacturers
  • Lead the full business development cycle — from opportunity identification to negotiation and long-term strategic planning
  • Translate scientific and technical capabilities into compelling commercial propositions
  • Collaborate closely with R&D, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to deliver integrated go-to-market strategies
  • Manage contracts, commercial terms, and performance optimisation across partnership lifecycles
  • Support international expansion through new market development and strategic alliances
  • Represent the business at leading industry trade shows and events to strengthen brand visibility and network reach.


Key Requirements

  • You can be located anywhere within South America to qualify for this market.
  • 8+ years’ experience in business development, partnerships, or commercial leadership within nutraceuticals, ingredients, food, or life sciences within South America.
  • A well-established book of business and strong relationships across the nutraceutical ecosystem
  • Direct experience selling tablets, capsules, softgels, gummys, or related dosage forms
  • Proven ability to generate revenue growth and close complex commercial agreements
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to convert technical innovation into business value
  • Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth, hands-on environment
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Willingness to travel internationally as needed.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Remote

Must follow and support US time zones

Enterprise Architect


Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Economics, Sociology, or another related field.
  • 8+ years of IT experience required.
  • 4+ years of architecture experience in multiple architectural domains such as business, information, application, integration, technology, and security.
  • Ability to make decisions and recommendations on technology strategies while considering various options and business needs.
  • Awareness of retail, supply chain, manufacturing, or consumer goods industries.
  • TOGAF, IASA or any other architecture-related certification is required.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


The Technical Architect provides the leadership, facilitation, analysis, and design tasks required for the development of an enterprise's technical architecture. They create deliverables that help develop target-state guidance (standards, guidelines, reference implementations) for evolving the technical infrastructure across the enterprise, to enable business strategy and deliver targeted business outcomes. They facilitate and orchestrate the delivery of targeted business outcomes through technical decisions.


  • Leads efforts to develop and maintain the architectural assets for the technical domain.
  • Sets an architecture direction for the technical domain that is aligned with business and IT goals.
  • Works with service management teams and solution architects to lower the total cost of ownership for IT capabilities.
  • Represents enterprise architecture by advocating and sharing knowledge.
  • Participates as a member of one or more architectural review boards (ARB) that ensure architecture quality and compliance.


  • Integration Architecture
  • Application Architecture
  • Technical Architecture
  • New Technology Innovation
  • Architecture Work
  • Modeling & Design:


Standard Setting:

  • Leads the creation of technical standards within area(s) of responsibility
  • Responsible for updating work products and communication when changes are required

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Security Researcher (GReAT)
description:
Established in 2008, Global Research & Analysis Team (GReAT) operates at the very heart of Kaspersky, uncovering APTs, cyber-espionage campaigns, major malware, ransomware, and underground cyber-criminal trends across the world. Today GReAT consists of 40+ experts working globally – in Europe, Russia, Americas, Asia, Middle East. Talented security professionals provide company leadership in anti-malware research and innovation, bringing unrivaled expertise, passion and curiosity to the discovery and analysis of cyberthreats.


Rights / Responsibilities:

  • Monitor, analyze and understand malware trends at local, regional and global level
  • Content creation: Analyze and describe ongoing APT and Crimeware campaigns worldwide
  • Enhance the Threat Intelligence products developed by Kaspersky
  • Present about IT security to wide audiences (cybersecurity community, customers, journalists, etc...)
  • Give interviews about various cybersecurity trends and topics
  • Suggest ideas to be implemented in company’s products
  • Prototype development: imagine and develop prototypes or new technologies
  • Take an active part in the formation of requirements for the internal infrastructure of Kaspersky
  • Participate in the development of the unit's recommended practices and standards, assume responsibility for accomplishing group goals
  • Ensure a proper level of information security, including any devices that are used to work with company's infrastructure


Specialist knowledge:

  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Ability to analyze and understand malicious code (Windows PE, .Net, OLE2, JS, VBS, HTML, PDF, SWF, ELF)
  • Good knowledge of Intel x86 assembler
  • Ability to use IDA or Ghidra for reverse engineering
  • Good knowledge of WinAPI
  • Basic knowledge of Linux API / kernel / POSIX
  • Excellent knowledge of Windows PE file format
  • Good experience in using at least one of following programming languages: C/C++/C#/Java/Python/Go/Rust
  • Knowledge of the operating principles of TCP/IP sockets
  • Technical article writing skills
  • Understanding of modern Threat Landscape as well as Threat Intelligence industry

title: Enterprise Support Engineer
description:
About HotMic


HotMic builds AI-powered video creation workflows that help creators and media teams produce high-quality content faster and more efficiently. We operate our own platform and also work closely with large enterprise customers to deliver custom, high-impact solutions.



Role Overview


We are hiring a Senior Enterprise Support Engineer to work directly with one major enterprise customer. This is a hands-on role involving both full-stack JavaScript development and customer-facing support. You will gather requirements, develop and ship customer-specific features, resolve issues, and keep the customer updated through calls and messages. You’ll also participate in our regular engineering sprints alongside other developers and product staff.



Responsibilities


  • Develop and deliver features tailored to a large enterprise customer.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Communicate directly with the customer via calls and messages.
  • Work within engineering sprints and coordinate with internal teams.
  • Maintain clear, fluent English communication.



Requirements


  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Senior-level full-stack JavaScript experience.
  • Experience working in structured team sprints.
  • Background working with enterprise customers or complex implementations.
  • Comfortable in a mixed engineering + support role.
  • Strong teamwork and ability to work independently.

title: Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer
description:
Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer - Remote - Brazil


ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development


We are currently seeking a Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in developing and implementing programming solutions to support the analysis and reporting of clinical trial data. You will contribute to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies by ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of data processing through your programming expertise.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Develop, validate, and maintain programming solutions for CDMS (EDC systems such as Rave/Veeva), data validation outputs, data review/risk management outputs, custom reports, and programs in clinical trials.
  • Collaborate with data managers, project managers, clinical data scientists, and biostatisticians to ensure the integration of programming solutions into the overall data management process.
  • Act as a primary point of contact during the study set up and maintenance phase for system programming related questions by the project team.
  • Support colleagues with the clinical trials environment and concepts of Clinical Data Management Systems.
  • Perform extracts of data from CDMS and creation of data transfer programs.
  • Act as mentor and provides guidance and support to more junior programmer levels assigned to a project.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of improvements to technical systems and processes within an SME role.
  • Provide guidance on programming best practices, coding standards, and data quality control measures.
  • Stay updated on advancements in programming languages and data management tools to enhance operational efficiencies.


Your Profile:

  • Complete bachelor’s degree relevant field such as computer science, SAS, statistics, or life sciences.
  • Extensive experience in programming for CDMS (EDC systems such as Rave/Veeva), data validation outputs, data review/risk management outputs, custom reports, and programs in clinical trials with proficiency in languages such as SAS, R, or Python.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with a commitment to delivering high-quality results.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and influence outcomes.
  • MUST HAVE advanced English Communication, Writing and Reading

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

description:

Resumo: O Vendedor Interno, ou Inside Sales, opera diretamente de um escritório ou de casa. Este profissional utiliza ferramentas digitais como e-mail, WhatsApp, telefone e videoconferências para prospectar, negociar e fechar vendas, sem a necessidade de deslocamentos externos. A posição exige um alto nível de conhecimento técnico sobre os produtos, excelente capacidade de comunicação e uma forte habilidade em vendas e persuasão.

Tipo de Operação: venda de infoprodutos


Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:

  • Prospecção ativa de novos clientes por meio de chamadas telefônicas, e-mails e reuniões por videoconferência.
  • Realização de apresentações detalhadas sobre os produtos e serviços para os clientes.
  • Envio e negociação de propostas comerciais, seguindo o acompanhamento até o fechamento da venda.
  • Gerenciamento de relações com clientes através do CRM, mantendo um histórico detalhado de interações, necessidades e transações.
  • Resolução de dúvidas e fornecimento de informações adicionais aos clientes como parte do suporte pós-venda.
  • Organização e priorização diária das atividades de vendas para garantir o cumprimento de metas e prazos.


O que Buscamos: Pré-requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas internas ou televendas.
  • Profundo conhecimento dos produtos ou serviços oferecidos pela empresa.
  • Habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de CRM e plataformas de comunicação digital.
  • Capacidade de realizar múltiplas tarefas, organizar e priorizar de forma eficaz.


Habilidades:

  • Capacidade de compreender e atender às necessidades dos clientes, construindo relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Paciência e habilidade para gerenciar o ciclo de vendas completo, do primeiro contato ao fechamento e follow-up.
  • Empatia para se conectar com clientes e entender suas demandas específicas.
  • Agilidade e precisão no atendimento, proporcionando respostas rápidas e soluções adequadas.


Desejável:

  • Formação em Marketing, Administração, Vendas ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência anterior em ambientes de vendas B2B / B2C.

Remuneração e Benefícios:

  • Salário base competitivo com comissão sobre as vendas..
  • Acesso a treinamentos e desenvolvimento profissional.

Adicionais:

  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento dentro da empresa.
  • Cultura empresarial de suporte e inovação.

title: Local Operations & Project Manager (Brazil)
description:
About TopDoer

TopDoer is a Workforce Management (WFM) platform helping companies instantly meet their workforce needs by connecting them with reliable freelancers and blue-collar workers on demand . We support businesses in scaling operations fast, efficiently, and with full flexibility.


Role Description

We are looking for an experienced Operations & Project Manager to lead our local activities in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone with strong leadership skills, excellent communication abilities, and a hands-on approach to operational management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and support the performance of the local operational team .
  • Manage and oversee daily work of local service providers (ISPs) .
  • Communicate with clients: resolve incidents, clarify needs, collect feedback to improve processes and product quality.
  • Contribute to planning and monitor achievement of financial KPIs .


Requirements

  • Legal residence in Brazil (Brazilian passport or valid residence permit ).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English or Russian (mandatory)
  • Proven experience in project management and team leadership .


Schedule

Full-time — flexibility required (24/7 operations environment

title: SEM Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga – SEM Manager

Na Texonica Innovations , acreditamos na importância da estratégia, experimentação e otimização contínua. Cada projeto é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com criatividade, precisão e curiosidade, gerando resultados reais.

Nosso time é composto por profissionais experientes, que compartilham conhecimento e oferecem um ambiente para você crescer e entregar o seu melhor trabalho. Fornecemos recursos para seu desenvolvimento profissional — cursos, mentorias e oportunidades reais de evolução. Valorizamos pessoas com sede de aprendizado e vontade de se desenvolver continuamente.

Responsabilidades

Planejar, executar e otimizar campanhas de Search Engine Marketing (Google Ads, Bing e outros).

Realizar pesquisa de palavras-chave, análise de público e de concorrentes para identificar oportunidades de crescimento.

Criar textos publicitários atraentes e testar variações para maximizar CTR e conversões.

Monitorar métricas de desempenho, interpretar dados e aplicar otimizações baseadas em insights.

Colaborar com equipes de criação, análise e estratégia para alinhar as iniciativas de SEM com os objetivos gerais de marketing.

Responder rapidamente a feedbacks e ajustar campanhas para garantir performance e eficiência.

Requisitos

Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência prática em SEM.

Domínio do Google Ads, ferramentas de pesquisa de palavras-chave e rastreamento de conversões.

Perfil analítico, proativo e atento aos detalhes.

Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas campanhas simultaneamente.

Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar de forma eficaz em ambiente remoto.

Diferenciais

Certificação em Google Ads.

Experiência com CRO, retargeting ou testes de landing pages.

Conhecimento de outras ferramentas ou plataformas de marketing de performance.

Sobre a Posição

Regime: Full-time ou Part-time

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Remuneração: A combinar

title: Engenheiro de obras
description:
Venha fazer parte da Masterboi!

Somos da Masterboi, uma empresa genuinamente Pernambucana dedicada a alimentar vidas, com matriz em Recife – PE, há mais de 24 anos construindo história no mercado nacional e internacional de processamento e distribuição de alimentos, tornando-se referência no segmento.

Estamos buscando um talento para a posição de:


Engenheiro de Obras (CLT / Presencial)

  • Elaborar, analisar e acompanhar cronogramas físico-financeiros da obra.
  • Planejar recursos (mão de obra, materiais, equipamentos e serviços) para garantir o andamento dentro do prazo e orçamento.
  • Identificar riscos e propor ações corretivas ou preventivas.
  • Interpretar projetos arquitetônicos, estruturais, elétricos, hidráulicos e complementares.
  • Garantir a conformidade técnica das atividades, conforme normas técnicas (ABNT), legislação e boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Elaborar e revisar memoriais descritivos, especificações técnicas e procedimentos executivo.
  • Supervisionar equipes próprias e de empreiteiras, garantindo execução de acordo com os projetos.
  • Controlar a qualidade dos serviços executados, realizando inspeções e ensaios, quando necessário.
  • Monitorar diariamente o progresso da obra e registrar ocorrências relevantes.
  • Solicitar, controlar e aprovar materiais, comparando especificações com o projeto.
  • Analisar medições e notas fiscais de fornecedores e empreiteiras.
  • Participar na negociação e contratação de serviços terceirizados.
  • Acompanhar custos, evitando desvios orçamentários.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança (NRs).
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe de obra, fornecedores e clientes.
  • Preparar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais sobre o andamento da obra.
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre o canteiro e a diretoria/gerência de engenharia.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Engenharia Civil/ Mecânica ou Elétrica com CREA ativo
  • Conhecimento em gestão de obras, planejamento e execução.
  • Domínio de cronogramas (MS Project ou similares).
  • Leitura e interpretação de projetos estruturais, arquitetônicos e complementares.


Informações adicionais:

  • Compras facilitadas nas lojas Masterboi;
  • Refeitório da empresa;
  • Seguro de vida e bem-estar;
  • Parcerias educacionais: Descontos em cursos técnicos e de nível superior.
  • Plano de Saúde por adesão.
  • Wellhub- Gympass


Venha fazer parte de um time incrível de pessoas!

title: Analista de Serviços Pleno (CLOUD)
description:
O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Realizar o atendimento aos ambientes dos clientes Cloud por meio dos canais TOTVS, solucionando demandas de baixa complexidade relacionadas à infraestrutura;
  • Revisar e classificar os tickets, quando necessário, conforme a categoria adequada e os processos definidos, garantindo o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas;
  • Registrar as solicitações dos clientes com todas as evidências e detalhes necessários, assegurando a rastreabilidade e a comunicação entre os envolvidos;
  • Analisar os tickets abertos pelos clientes, reclassificando ou categorizando conforme os procedimentos documentados pela área, para correta adequação da demanda;
  • Fornecer atualizações sobre o andamento das solicitações, quando solicitado, por meio dos canais de atendimento disponíveis (telefone, e-mail ou sistema);
  • Escalonar para o próximo nível as solicitações ou incidentes não resolvidos, após o esgotamento das possibilidades de solução dentro do prazo estimado pela Coordenação, registrando detalhadamente as ações executadas e os resultados obtidos;
  • Contribuir para o atingimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, satisfação do cliente, entre outros) e das metas da área, seguindo os procedimentos e padrões estabelecidos para o ambiente Cloud;
  • Alertar a coordenação e a liderança sobre possíveis riscos ou situações críticas em clientes, registrando os tickets conforme os procedimentos internos definidos pela área.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Graduação completa ou em andamento nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.
  • Administração de ambientes relacionados ao produto TOTVS – nível básico;
  • Infraestrutura e Datacenter – nível básico;
  • Infraestrutura de Nuvens Públicas – nível básico;
  • Ferramentas de Automação – nível básico.
  • Desejável: ITIL Foundation (Information Technology Infrastructure Library).
  • Inglês – nível básico.

title: Administrador de Banco de Dados (DBA) Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Mapear todos os bancos e tabelas com campos relacionados ao CNPJ.

Ajustar schemas, tipos de dados, índices e constraints conforme o novo padrão.

Garantir consistência entre ambientes (desenvolvimento, teste, produção).

Apoiar desenvolvedores e engenheiros de dados na execução de scripts de atualização.

Validar e otimizar consultas SQL impactadas pela mudança.

Gerenciar migrações, backups e restores durante o processo de alteração.

Garantir a segurança e a governança de acesso aos bancos de dados.

Habilidades e Requisitos

- Criptografia de Dados

- ADMINISTRACAO DE BANCO DE DADOS: SQL SERVER, ORACLE SQL

- BANCO DE DADOS: ORACLE SQL DEVELOPER, MONGODB

- CRIACAO DE INDICES

- ARQUITETURAS PARALELAS E DISTRIBUIDAS

- ANALISE DE PERFORMANCE E TUNING

- ADMINISTRACAO DE BANCO DE DADOS (DBA)

- SQL SERVER ALWAYS ON

- CONTROLE DE VERSIONAMENTO (GIT / GITHUB / GITLAB)

- APIS E SCRIPTS (PYTHON, SHELL, POWERSHELL)

- AJUSTE DE STORED PROCEDURES

- DATA MASKING

- DATABASE MIRRORING

- AJUSTES EM TRIGGERS

- PARTICIONAMENTO DE DADOS

- AMBIENTES DE DESENVOLVIMENTO INTEGRADOS

- CONSTRAINTS

- LOG S

Formato de trabalho:Remoto

E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

Estamos em busca de um Microsoft Platform Engineer Sênior para atuar em um projeto internacional de grande porte, em uma empresa global do setor de soluções corporativas e serviços de tecnologia com foco em modernização digital e colaboração em nuvem .

O profissional será responsável pela administração e engenharia de plataformas Microsoft 365, com foco em:

  • SharePoint / OneDrive (administração avançada)

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote - Brazil

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.


Business Systems Analyst | About You

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You’re comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes. You are detail-oriented, naturally curious, and confident working independently to drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.


Business Systems Analyst | Day-to-Day

  • Triage and resolve data issues within the Pay-Per-Use program by identifying root causes and directing them to the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain and manage the team’s Jira board, including issue tracking, documentation, and validation of outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot and update Tableau reports (10–15 dashboards), ensuring accuracy and relevance of the displayed data.
  • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.


Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Proficient in writing SQL queries for data investigation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.
  • Skilled in managing issues in Jira and working across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with navigating Salesforce and SAP for data verification (no development or admin experience required).

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior (Inglês Fluente)
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior — Inglês Fluente


Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior para atuar em um projeto internacional de transformação digital em uma empresa global que atua com design de experiências, inovação e soluções de tecnologia para grandes marcas internacionais .


❗ A atuação será 100% remota no fuso horário EST (EUA) , com contratação contractor via Deel e início imediato .


✨ Responsabilidades:

O(a) profissional será responsável por desenvolver e manter aplicações web completas — desde interfaces modernas e responsivas até APIs, lógica de negócio e banco de dados. Entre as atividades:

  • Implementar interfaces front-end responsivas usando HTML5, CSS3 e JavaScript (ES6+) , com experiência em Vue.js ou React .
  • Criar e manter APIs e serviços back-end utilizando .NET Core/IIS e Entity Framework .
  • Trabalhar com bancos relacionais (MS SQL, MySQL ou Azure SQL ), modelagem e otimização de queries.
  • Garantir qualidade, segurança, escalabilidade e performance das aplicações.
  • Participar ativamente de arquitetura, code reviews, testes automatizados e melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com designers, PMs e desenvolvedores em ambiente ágil , contribuindo para soluções de ponta a ponta.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de sistemas
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento ágil, garantindo a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e alinhadas às metas de negócio.

- Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de sistemas, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia de software, segurança da informação, automação e observabilidade.

- Atuar como facilitador entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, traduzindo necessidades estratégicas em soluções tecnológicas eficientes.

- Conduzir o planejamento e acompanhamento de projetos, assegurando prazos, custos, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e qualidade das entregas.

- Implementar padrões de governança técnica, versionamento, testes automatizados, CI/CD e monitoramento contínuo de performance.

- Apoiar o crescimento técnico do time por meio de mentorias, feedbacks estruturados e planos de desenvolvimento individual.

- Fomentar uma cultura de colaboração, aprendizado contínuo, inovação e melhoria constante nos processos de desenvolvimento.

- Participar ativamente de decisões estratégicas sobre tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento que impactem a arquitetura corporativa.

- Promover o uso racional de recursos em nuvem, garantindo eficiência operacional, segurança e sustentabilidade financeira.

- Atuar na mitigação de riscos técnicos e na resolução de incidentes críticos, com foco em análise de causa raiz e prevenção.


Requisitos e qualificações:

- Experiência comprovada em Engenharia de Software, Arquitetura de Sistemas e Liderança Técnica de equipes ágeis de alta performance.

- Domínio técnico em:

- Arquitetura de microserviços e integração de sistemas distribuídos

- Cloud Computing (preferencialmente AWS, Azure ou GCP)

- Banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais

- Mensageria e streaming de dados (ex: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ)

- APIs RESTful, GraphQL e boas práticas de versionamento

- Ferramentas de CI/CD, containers (Docker, Kubernetes) e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)

- Forte conhecimento em metodologias Agile/Scrum/Kanban, gestão de backlog e métricas de produtividade técnica (lead time, throughput, qualidade de código).

- Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

- Certificações desejáveis: Scrum Master, AWS Solutions Architect, DevOps, Cloud Practitioner ou similares.

- Excelentes habilidades de liderança, comunicação assertiva, gestão de conflitos, visão sistêmica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

- Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de atuar estrategicamente e operacionalmente quando necessário.

- Proatividade, curiosidade tecnológica e capacidade de inspirar e engajar pessoas em torno de objetivos comuns.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and/or sales opportunities with key customers.
The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.
In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.
Your Impact
  • Escalation Leadership
    • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
    • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
    • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
    • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
    • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
    • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
    • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
    • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
    • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
    • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
    • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
    • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
    • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
    • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
    • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
    • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process/system/product
    • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
    • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
    • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
    • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Fully fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish both written and verbal
  • Customer Experience
    • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and/or service delivery roles
    • Past experience as Escalations Engineer/Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
    • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program/Project management
    • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
    • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
    • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA/SLO/Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
    • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
    • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
    • Experience with Networking/Security Products
    • Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, encompassing general routing/switching/security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues
Additional Information
The Team
The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.
Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making
As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.
Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and/or sales opportunities with key customers.
The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.
In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.
Your Impact
  • Escalation Leadership
    • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
    • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
    • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
    • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
    • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
    • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
    • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
    • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
    • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
    • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
    • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
    • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
    • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
    • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
    • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
    • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process/system/product
    • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
    • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
    • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
    • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Fully fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish both written and verbal
  • Customer Experience
    • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and/or service delivery roles
    • Past experience as Escalations Engineer/Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
    • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program/Project management
    • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
    • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
    • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA/SLO/Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
    • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
    • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
    • Experience with Networking/Security Products
    • Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, encompassing general routing/switching/security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues
Additional Information
The Team
The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.
Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making
As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.
Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Company Description


C17 Lab is a revenue engineering firm dedicated to helping B2B organizations address capability and capacity challenges across go-to-market and revenue operations. We specialize in building outbound-led growth systems that turn buying intent into scalable revenue through data-driven processes and accountability. Collaborating with clients ranging from startups to enterprises, we focus on creating financially sustainable growth while exceeding pipeline and revenue goals. Our team offers hands-on support across the full revenue cycle, including go-to-market strategies, demand generation, pipeline management, and revenue operations with CRM integration and reporting.


Role Description


This is a full-time remote role for an Executive Assistant. The Executive Assistant will handle a range of administrative duties, including executive support, managing expense reports, scheduling meetings, organizing calendars, and providing general administrative assistance. The role requires a high level of communication and organizational skills, as well as the ability to manage confidential information and prioritize competing tasks to support executive leadership effectively.


Qualifications


  • Proficiency in Executive Administrative Assistance and Administrative Assistance, with the ability to manage calendars, scheduling, and office operations.
  • 4-10 years of experience as Executive Assistant.
  • Complete fluency in English, both spoken and written.
  • Experience in Expense Reports and related financial administrative tasks.
  • Strong skills in Executive Support, ensuring seamless assistance for senior leaders in daily operations.
  • Excellent Communication skills, including written and verbal communication, with attention to detail.
  • High level of organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities.
  • Proficiency with office productivity tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Claude/ChatGPT
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a remote environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience is a plus.
